title: use-mcp React Integration
excerpt: use mcp React Integration This package provides the useMcp hook for easily integrating the Model Context Protocol (MCP) into your React applications. Installation Ensure you have use mcp, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, react, and react dom installed: useMcp Hook The useMcp hook manages the connection to an MCP server, handles authentication (including OAuth), and provides the list of available tools and functions to interact with the server.
